mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, description, sync_strategy, locked_fields, preset, version, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM role_template WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, code, name, description, sync_strategy, locked_fields, preset, version, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM role_template WHERE code = #{code} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, code, name, description, sync_strategy, locked_fields, preset, version, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM role_template ORDER BY preset DESC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role_template ( code, name, description, sync_strategy, locked_fields, preset, version, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{syncStrategy}, #{lockedFields}, #{preset}, #{version}, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) )
mapper.update: UPDATE role_template SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, sync_strategy = #{syncStrategy}, locked_fields = #{lockedFields}, version = #{version}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
